test_title: PYST 19: RRB Group D - Reasoning (Held On: 05 Dec, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
Refer to the following number and symbol series and answer the question that follows. Counting to be done from left to right only. All numbers are single-digit numbers.

(Left) 3 & 6 © 3 6 © € % 6 & 4 9 5 4 % € £ $ % 9 1 (Right)

How many such numbers are there, each of which is immediately preceded by a symbol and also immediately followed by a symbol?
solution:
**Given:** (Left) 3 & 6 © 3 6 © € % 6 & 4 9 5 4 % € £ $ % 9 1 (Right)

Now,

Numbers, each of which is immediately preceded by a symbol and also immediately followed by a symbol.

So, the needed pattern is: Symbol — Number — Symbol

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0c0d27d97addbecf9a2426aecf4834129736b8b930ba0b3034432d05217f545e.png] 

 

Thus, there are 2 numbers, each of which is immediately preceded by a symbol and also immediately followed by a symbol.

Hence, the correct answer is "**Option 1**".
